\section{\texttt{evaluate\_system}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.evaluation.evaluate_system}\index{Functions!evaluate\_system}

Evaluate retrieval and answer quality and aggregate a typed report.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
evaluate_system(query_engine: Retriever, agent: FeedbackInsightAgent, cases: list[EvaluationCase], *, top_k: int = 4, telemetry: Telemetry | None = None) -> EvaluationReport
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{query\_\allowbreak{}engine}] \texttt{Retriever}, required.
  \item[\texttt{agent}] \texttt{FeedbackInsightAgent}, required.
  \item[\texttt{cases}] \texttt{list[EvaluationCase]\allowbreak{}}, required.
  \item[\texttt{top\_\allowbreak{}k}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{telemetry}] \texttt{Telemetry \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{EvaluationReport}
\apifield{Details}Retrieval metrics are averaged over answerable cases only, because unanswerable cases have no relevant documents to retrieve. Answer metrics are averaged over all cases. When a telemetry emitter is provided, an \texttt{evaluation\_\allowbreak{}finished} event with aggregate metrics is emitted.
